name: web-cobalt-wavy-bakery-storefront
title: Bakery storefront in cobalt with wavy dividers and condensed type
whatItIs: A long multi-view website: a cobalt hero with cake photos and a huge condensed 'THE CAKE SHOP', white product grids with price badges, a pink 'Fillings' band, a curved how-to-order path with numbered steps, an Instagram strip, and a laptop showing a product page. Sections are separated by wavy edges.
whatItMeans: Joyful and confectionery-like; the wavy edges feel like icing and the bold blue makes each cake glow.
techniques: Cut section boundaries with wavy lines to echo the product (icing) and keep a long page flowing.
Set section titles in huge tall condensed type cropped by the frame for drama.
Put price in small round badges on the corner of each product photo.
Break the blue with one pink section for rhythm.
Draw a looping thin line between numbered steps to make a process feel like a journey.

vocabulary.definition: A curved edge separating two colour sections.
A tall narrow typeface used at huge size.
A small round label overlapping a product image.
A curved line linking numbered steps.
